### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Only attribute durations to symptoms when explicitly stated and directly linked to that specific symptom in the transcript. Do not infer or extend durations from other symptoms.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Accurately reflect all patient-reported symptoms and denials; do not contradict explicit patient statements. When reporting medication use, precisely state the condition or reason for which the patient uses it, as explicitly mentioned in the transcript; avoid inferring or misattributing the purpose of medication.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Ground all subjective claims directly to explicit patient statements. Do not contradict, invert, or negate patient-reported symptoms or denials. For medication use, strictly adhere to the patient's stated reason; do not infer or substitute conditions.
